hints.title: Bidirectional Entry Advantage
hints.text: Boxes can enter from either the left entrance or the right entrance.

hints.title: Effective Height Minimum Bounds
hints.text: Room i can be accessed from the left with capacity min(warehouse[0..i]) or from the right with capacity min(warehouse[i..n-1]).

hints.title: Greedy Outermost Placement
hints.text: Sort boxes descending, and place each box into the most restrictive valid boundary room available.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting boxes takes O(B log B) time, and two-pointer placement scans the warehouse in O(W) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all permutations of which side each box enters from leads to exponential branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual-pointer convergence places largest boxes greedily at outer edges without extra memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Greedy two-pointer placement sorting boxes descending and filling available ends.

solutions.approach: Descending Box Sort with Two-Pointer End Allocation
